summary: You feel things at a depth most people never touch, and you can handle it. You read the undercurrent in a room, sense what's really going on under the surface. Intensity comes easy to you.
body: You feel things at a depth most people never touch, and you can handle it. You read the undercurrent in a room, sense what's really going on under the surface. Intensity comes easy to you. You can sit with grief, rage, the heavy stuff, and come out the other side stronger, even able to help others through it. The gift is so natural you can take it for granted, or use the depth to read everyone but yourself. Turn it inward and you become someone who heals, not just senses.
gift: At your best: deep, perceptive, able to regenerate from anything.
shadow: The trap: reading everyone else's depths while skipping your own.
integration: Let emotional needs and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Emotional intensity: depth is an asset, volatility a liability.
do: Turn the depth on yourself, not just others
Trust what you sense under the surface
dont: Use perception to stay in control
